en.title: Legal Steps for Buying and Selling Land
en.directAnswer: A safe land sale has three parts: checks before payment, a correct deed and registration, and record updates after registration. The largest risk usually comes from paying before ownership and property details are properly checked.

atAGlance.whoFor: A citizen wants an end-to-end property transaction checklist.
atAGlance.legalBasis: Transfer of Property Act, 1882; Registration Act, 1908; Ministry of Land procedures.
atAGlance.mainRule: The transaction should connect the seller, the land description, the title chain and the official records.
atAGlance.updateStatus: Use the current 2026 Registration Act text for all timing and registration statements.

en.lawMeaning: The transaction should connect the seller, the land description, the title chain and the official records. This page gives a general route. A person’s exact rights can change because of facts, documents, deadlines, legal status, court orders or later amendments.
steps: Check mutation, tax and mortgage information.
evidence: Identity; deeds; khatian; map; mutation; tax record; mortgage information; payment proof; power of attorney if used.
en.simpleExample: Nadia pays only a small documented advance after verification begins. The final payment is linked to a verified deed and registration process. This is safer than paying most of the price before checks.
commonMistakes: Common mistakes: Cash payment without receipt.
